title: Comfort Club Refrigerant Coverage on Sealed-System Repairs
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements cover refrigerant on a member's repair call only when the call carries a sealed-system major repair. The test reads the repair lines posted on the member's call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls.

**Sealed-system major repair tasks:** compressor replacement, evaporator coil replacement, condenser coil replacement, reversing valve replacement and TXV replacement.

## Refrigerant rule
The refrigerant beyond the allowance — the refrigerant lines of the call less the member refrigerant allowance already posted on the call — is covered at a refrigerant coverage rate as follows:

| Repair lines on the call | Consecutive term count | Refrigerant coverage rate |
|---|---|---|
| Include a sealed-system major repair task | 10 or more (at least the tenth term) | 1.0 — the long-standing rate, the refrigerant beyond the allowance in full |
| Include a sealed-system major repair task | 9 or fewer | 0.5 — the sealed-system rate, half of it |
| Include no such task | any | no refrigerant coverage under this rule |

The amount added is the refrigerant beyond the allowance multiplied by the rate.

## Examples (hypothetical call: refrigerant billed 180.00, member allowance posted 60.00)
- Compressor replacement, agreement in its 12th term: 120.00 multiplied by 1.0 adds 120.00.
- Evaporator coil replacement, agreement in its 4th term: 120.00 multiplied by 0.5 adds 60.00.
- Refrigerant top-up with a capacitor replacement only: no sealed-system task, nothing added under this rule.

## Basis questions
**Does a TXV replacement qualify?** Yes, it is one of the five listed tasks.

**Is the tenth term itself enough for the long-standing rate?** Yes: "at least its tenth consecutive term" includes a count of exactly 10.
